headline: This adds a stored "yes, send me the newsletter" setting for patients, off by default, and sends nothing yet.
what_changed: Each patient record now has a newsletter choice, set to off for everyone, including existing patients.
A new internal function can switch that choice on or off for a given patient. Nothing on the profile page uses it yet in this change.
A database change adds the new setting to the patient records. It can be reversed.
No emails or texts are sent by this change. The newsletter itself is described as upcoming.
questions_for_developer: When the newsletter is built, will it only email patients whose newsletter setting is on, and will it also respect the existing text-message opt-out?
Where is the new switch-on-or-off function called from, and does that caller check that the logged-in patient is the one whose setting is being changed?
Will existing patients be asked to opt in before any newsletter goes out, so none are added by default?
good_news: The change is small and contained: one new setting, one new function, and one database change.
The new setting defaults to off, so no patient is opted in without choosing it.
The database change can be undone with the matching reverse step, which removes only the new setting.
